# Feature Request

Thanks for taking the time to suggest an improvement to AnswerTrace.

## Problem

What problem would this feature solve?

Describe the limitation, pain point, or use case as clearly as possible.

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you think the feature should work.

Explain the expected behavior and what the user experience should look like.

## Example

If possible, provide an example of how the feature could be used.

For example:

```yaml
- name: Example
  uses: antonisloukis/answertrace@v1
  with:
    username: YOUR_GITHUB_USERNAME
```

You can also include mockups, screenshots, command examples, or expected output.

## Alternatives Considered

Are there other approaches or workarounds you considered?

Explain why the proposed solution would be preferable.

## Additional Context

Add any other information that may help explain the request.

This may include:

- Screenshots
- Links
- Related tools
- Similar implementations
- Example workflows
- GitHub API limitations
- Relevant Discussions or issues

## Impact

Who would benefit from this feature?

Examples:

- GitHub profile users
- Open-source maintainers
- GitHub Discussions contributors
- GitHub Actions users
- AnswerTrace CLI users

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched existing issues and did not find the same feature request.
- [ ] I described the problem this feature would solve.
- [ ] I explained the proposed solution.
- [ ] I included examples or additional context where useful.
- [ ] This request is related to the scope of AnswerTrace.
